decisions.reason: The smooth high-speed mixing constraint is already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the splash-control change requires no additional candidate update.
The client identifies bowl-depth adjustment only as an optional splash mitigation if necessary and does not change the selected bowl depth, capacity, or geometry.
The approved speed range and mixing modes are already represented by the candidate's same-message MODIFY; the splash constraint adds no further speed-drive state change.
The maximum-speed duty constraint is already represented by the candidate's same-message INTRODUCE and is not further changed by the splash-control decision.
The source concerns splashing during higher-speed mixing, not dispensing flow, valve control, dripping, or the dispensing sequence.
Optional whisk-position or bowl-depth adjustment does not alter the requirement that bowls be quickly removable and swappable.
Controlling splashing at higher mixing speeds does not modify the existing sealing requirement preventing liquid from entering the base or electronics.
The source permits several optional splash mitigations but does not require adding a specific guard or other component to the BOM.
The splash-control decision does not affect placard text, position, or customer-facing orientation.
The source does not change the unit's anti-rattle, anti-shift, base, or foot requirements; any effect of higher speed on vibration would be an unsupported engineering inference.
The source addresses clean operation through splash mitigation, not removal, flushing, or cleaning of the dispensing path.
The higher-speed splash constraint and optional mechanical mitigations do not alter the DJ turntable visual theme.
